site.name: Alex Rivers
site.headline: Fast, reliable plugins for Paper & Spigot servers.
site.tagline: Server software that stays out of the way — no lag spikes, no bloated configs, no surprises at 3am.
site.about: I've been writing Java for Minecraft servers since 2019. I focus on Paper-first plugins: async where it matters, minimal dependencies, and APIs other developers can build on. When I'm not patching a scheduler, I'm profiling one.
